quotes.quote: The modern organization operates most effectively by orienting itself around highly empowered teams who broaden their capabilities to absorb cross-team and cross-functional handoffs, can rely on automated harnesses to address most remaining cross-functional approvals, and accelerate high-quality decision making through rapid prototyping. The premise here is an old one, but AI-tooling has shifted what’s possible in remarkable ways.
quotes.title: Roadmap decisions rather than dates.
